method: Two first-frame sheets, three animation sheets and enlarged PEPEWAY source inspected. Full CDN source is 400x560 single-frame GIF, 175613 bytes; visually dense repeated pattern. Eleven animations sampled at four spaced positions, all four DWAYNEKEK and all three GIVEAWAYPEPE frames included. Longer animations not exhaustive. Existing WAYOFFEELS/WAYOFTHEFEEL similarity remains a separate earlier followup; no inference about that direction here.
